name: synthetic-absent-ancestor
description: A lineage with every grandparent slot empty. Each absent slot kills a base AND a bonus term, so it contributes two zero nodes and the sum invariant still holds. individualAffinity still emits keys 11/12/21/22 so box browse can render a uniform six-slot tree.
provenance: Synthetic. All 259 lineages in the builder's roster are six-member complete, so this case has no natural test.
